what_it_does: Presents WarpDrive, a method to accelerate Fully Homomorphic Encryption (computing on encrypted data without decryption) on graphics processing units. The bottleneck is Number Theoretic Transform (NTT) operations—mathematical computations central to homomorphic encryption. These operations stall the GPU pipeline (execution units waiting idle) due to memory latency and underutilize both general-purpose GPU cores and specialized high-throughput math units. WarpDrive reduces total computation by 73 percent, eliminates most memory stalls, and uniquely runs both core types simultaneously.
